title: NFL team colours, 2026 season (current primary identity), for the ESPN NFL 2K5 scorebug
purpose: Authoritative per-team palette for the scorebug. Every scorebug accent must be one of a team's listed colours in the exact shade, or a lighter/darker variant of one for contrast. Colours flagged logo_detail_only are official logo details (for example a beak or eye) and are best avoided as large fills.

selection_rule.inclusion: A colour is listed when an official source supports it as a current 2026 team, logo or uniform colour: the 2026 NFL Record and Fact Book team colours, the NFL's own club logo file, or a team first-party page or publication. Neutral white and black also qualify when Wikipedia's current infobox lists them. Throwback-only colours, stale values and colours given only by third parties go to excluded_candidates with a reason.
selection_rule.hex_choice: In order: (1) a hex the team itself publishes (Colts brand page); (2) the NFL's own club logo file, for every colour that appears in the logo; (3) otherwise teamcolorcodes.com when current and consistent with the team's Pantone spec, else the value corroborated by the most sources (Wikipedia, nflverse); nflverse alone only as a last resort, flagged low confidence. Team Pantone specs are recorded in the pantone field.
selection_rule.normalisation: NFL logo files encode white as #FFFFFE and some blacks as rich-black mixes (#0A0A09, #0A0B09, #231F20). These are export artifacts and are recorded as #FFFFFF / #000000.
selection_rule.disputes: A colour is disputed when any of the NFL logo file, a team first-party hex, teamcolorcodes, Wikipedia or nflverse gives a different hex. Every value is kept with its source; team-site theme values are informational only.

dispute_severity_scale.metric: CIEDE2000 colour difference between the chosen hex and the alternate
